plain_english: I resort to You, Śambhu — supreme, beyond-abiding, beginningless, one, cave-entered manifoldly, abode of all, abiding in all moving and unmoving: to refuge.
sanskrit_cite: paraṃ parasthaṃ gahanād anādim | sarvālayaṃ sarvacarācarasthaṃ tvām eva śambhuṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye

plain_english: Whirled in the sorrow-wheel from womb-dwelling to death-ending, the student asked the blessed Lord, the support: the supreme truth.
By support-verses the teacher addressed its essence to him; Abhinavagupta tells it by Śiva-teaching-view-yoga.
sanskrit_cite: ādhārakārikābhiḥ taṃ gurur abhibhāṣati sma tatsāram | kathayaty abhinavaguptaḥ śivaśāsanadṛṣṭiyogena

plain_english: By own-power-glory-weight, this fourfold egg in division: power, Māyā, nature, earth — thus manifested by the Lord.
sanskrit_cite: nijaśaktivaibhavabharād a.ṅdacatuṣṭayam idaṃ vibhāgena | śaktir māyā prakṛtiḥ pṛthvī ceti prabhāvitaṃ prabhuṇā

plain_english: Therein within, this universe is a varied body-faculty-world continuum; and therein the enjoyer, embodied, is Śiva indeed, fettered-state-taken.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāntar viśvam idaṃ vicitratanukaraṇabhuvanasaṃtānam | bhoktā ca tatra dehī śiva eva gṛhītapaśubhāvaḥ

plain_english: As the stainless crystal assumes the form of various sorts, so the Lord too holds god-man-beast-plant form-ness.
sanskrit_cite: nānāvidhavarṇānāṃ rūpaṃ dhatte yathāmalaḥ sphaṭikaḥ | suramānuṣapaśupādaparūpatvaṃ tadvad īśo 'pi

plain_english: As water moves and the moon-disc moves, as water stills so stillness goes: so this self, the great Lord, in the body-faculty-world mass.
sanskrit_cite: gacchati gacchati jala iva himakarabimbaṃ sthite sthitiṃ yāti | tanukaraṇabhuvanavarge tathāyam ātmā maheśānaḥ

plain_english: As invisible Rahu, abiding on the moon-disc, shines, so the all-going self, by resorting to objects, shines in the mind-mirror.
sanskrit_cite: rāhur adṛśyo 'pi yathā śaśibimbasthaḥ prakāśate tadvat | sarvagato 'py ayam ātmā viṣayāśrayaṇena dhīmukure

plain_english: As a face shines in a dirt-free mirror, so this self shines, light-formed, in the mind-principle purified by Śiva's grace-descent.
sanskrit_cite: ādarśe malarahite yadvad vadanaṃ vibhāti tadvad ayam | śivaśaktipātavimale dhītattve bhāti bhārūpaḥ

plain_english: Light-formed, complete, great-bliss from resting in own self, filled by will, knowing and acting, endless-power-complete.
sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ svātmani viśrāntito mahānandam | icchasaṃvitkaraṇair nirbharitam anantaśaktiparipūrṇam
